abilities.name: Ultrahand

def execute_ultrahand_the(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Link lifts, moves, rotates and attaches compatible world objects together to create contraptions.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    region = validate_editable_world_area(actor,target)
    source_material = query_named_material_or_plant(region)
    apply_bounded_growth_terrain_or_corrosion_rule(region,source_material)
    update_navmesh_and_collision_invalidation(region)
    register_reversion_or_persistent_save_event()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS

abilities.name: Recall
abilities.canon_behavior: Link reverses the movement of a chosen object along its recent trajectory.
suggested_game_logic: Record a ring buffer of positions and rotations per eligible object.
When Recall runs, play object transforms backward along snapshots; keep Link at normal time.
Stop when buffer exhausted, canceled or interrupted.
abilities.canon_limitations: Object movement is rewound, NOT global game time or Link health.
